title: wg: room-policy-04 Table 1/appendix capability name inconsistencies
description: Erratum. §8.1.3 (L1550) canUnban vs Table 1 (L2046) canUnBan; appendix mixes both (L2452, L2537, ...). A.1 lists canRevokeVoice and canGrantVoice (L2456-2458), not in Table 1. Table 1 puts status in the name column ("canCreateJoinCode (reserved)", L2038ff). Decisions mimid-1wgh.3.23, .3.35, .3.36. Distinct from .3.38 and .3.39.
